continuity.campaign_development: 26 May 57 BCE: the newly authorized Roman expedition has advanced beyond the secondary passage and verified a substantial engineered route through unfamiliar country; estate administration, local access arrangements, agricultural work, commercial activity, and Roman correspondence continue independently.
continuity.land_area_history: Round 33 establishes 4.00 sq mi; Round 42 adds 0.25; Round 55 measures the earlier former-bandit aggregate; Round 59 adds 0.50 to reach 7.5625; Round 65 adds 0.125 to reach 7.6875; Round 75 adds 0.0625 sq mi (40 acres) through a documented purchase of the disputed tract, bringing total holdings to 7.75 sq mi.

special_event_policy.rule: Special is a core event category. Every round performs one independent random Special-event roll using the current base probability. A successful roll adds exactly one Special event; a failed roll adds none. Each successful Magnitude-11 check also produces a Special event. Magnitude-11 is separate from the standard Special roll and never converts a result into Ultimate.
special_event_policy.magnitude_11_policy: tracked separately only when required; a successful Magnitude-11 check generates an initially Special event, which must independently pass the Ultimate Reclassification Gate before final classification.

financial_reconciliation.inference_basis: Closest established analogous spring commercial precedent from Round 79, calibrated to current 7.75 sq mi estate scale and 'modest' narrative strength; no unsupported financial mechanism was introduced.
